lead.headline: Russian missiles land in Poland as NATO calls it a 'grave violation'
lead.summary: Two Russian missiles and a suspected drone came down in south-eastern Poland on Friday, near the Coalition of the Willing's war games. NATO chief Mark Rutte called it a grave violation of Polish airspace; Prime Minister Donald Tusk said it looked like a deliberate provocation. No one was hurt.

stories.headline: Wall Street sinks into correction as AI shares plunge
stories.summary: The S&P 500 fell 3.7% on Friday to 6,910, entering correction territory, and the Nasdaq fell 5.3% in its worst week since 2020. Nvidia dropped 14% after its chief executive's departure.

stories.headline: Three Houthi missiles aimed at Riyadh shot down on Saturday
stories.summary: Saudi air defences intercepted three ballistic missiles fired towards the capital on Saturday, the second attack on Riyadh in days, after its tallest skyscraper was struck on Thursday.

stories.headline: GTA 6 makes $3.79bn on day one — biggest launch in history
stories.summary: Rockstar and Take-Two said the game sold 32.5 million copies before release, making it the biggest entertainment launch ever.

stories.headline: Climate talks stall as fossil fuels vanish from draft deal
stories.summary: The COP31 talks in Antalya spilled into overtime on Friday after the draft dropped all mention of fossil fuels and a $120bn finance target. A new version is due on Saturday.

stories.headline: Denmark expels Russian attaché over 'assassination plot'
stories.summary: Denmark said Russian intelligence planned to kill rapper Kyivstoner at a Copenhagen concert in September. Two Danes are charged; the attaché has seven days to leave.
